title: Cloud City: Serverless Compute: Cloud Run, Functions, and Workflows
city_concept: On-Demand City Kiosks & Event-Driven Delivery Crews

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Brightloaf Bakery was paying 24/7 for 10 servers to handle order cancellations, even though cancellations only occurred twice an hour.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Tomas the Treasurer deployed on-demand popup kiosks (Cloud Run). When an order cancellation arrives, the kiosk springs open, handles the order, and vanishes.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During a sudden flash mob, 500 customers rushed the kiosk. Cloud Run automatically duplicated into 20 kiosks instantaneously without dropping an order.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In physical construction, popups require permits and setup crews; in Cloud Run, container instances scale to zero when idle with zero idle billing.
